project.name: DM Cockpit
project.type: Foundry VTT Modul plus lokaler Companion Service

working_rules.autonomy: Möglichst autonom weiterarbeiten. Nutzer nur bei echten externen Tests, Zugängen oder nicht sinnvoll ableitbaren Entscheidungen einbeziehen.
working_rules.github_sync_rule: Abgeschlossene Projekt-Arbeitsschritte auf GitHub dokumentieren; Foundry-Runtime-/Release-Änderungen zusätzlich mit Manifest, Installationspaket und Projektstatus synchronisieren.
working_rules.checkpoint_rule: In sinnvollen Abständen GitHub-Checkpoint plus JSON-Checkpoint im Chat bereitstellen.
working_rules.secret_rule: Discord Bot Token, API Keys, Passwörter und sonstige Secrets niemals im Chat oder GitHub speichern.

implemented: STT_PROVIDER selector with none as safe default
speaker name resolution from Discord User
successful final transcript returned through Protocol v1 to SQLite and Foundry
raw Opus packets released after successful or final failed STT job

provider_evaluation.decision: Deepgram first because raw Opus 48k stereo can be sent directly; architecture remains switchable.

current_user_assistance_needed.task: Create a Deepgram test API key and perform first real STT integration test.
current_user_assistance_needed.reason: The next step makes a real external paid/free-credit API call and therefore needs a user-owned provider account/key.
test_expected: terminal prints [stt] <Discord name>: recognized German text
same final text appears in Foundry Discord Live-Transkript

next_single_todo_after_successful_stt_te.task: Implement AI extraction candidate pipeline from final transcript segments without automatic Actor writes yet.
constraints: automatic writes only after Undo/change record path is ready

handoff_instruction_for_next_ai: DM Cockpit V0.9.21 is confirmed. Companion 0.1.0 WebSocket/SQLite, 0.2.0 Discord Voice/DAVE/GM follow, and 0.3.0 real speaker-separated Discord Opus receive are confirmed on the user's PC. Companion 0.4.0 adds a provider-neutral STT queue and a Deepgram Nova-3 adapter using raw Discord Opus directly via the EU endpoint. STT_PROVIDER defaults to none, so no cloud audio is sent unless explicitly enabled locally. The next external step is a Deepgram API key and one German speech test; never request the key in chat.
